title: Add sideprojects/infinite-canvas: a FoldKit prototype of an infinite canvas with rendered Explorer windows
statement: A standalone FoldKit (Effect/Elm-architecture) prototype inspired by Scott Tolinski showing a spatial infinite canvas of rendered Explorer windows on the latest Syntax episodes (agent workspaces, Opus 5.5/5.1 context). It lives under sideprojects/ like pdf-lab, is self-contained (own package.json, tests, build), and changes no accepted direction or existing module.
conditions: Prototype only: static in-memory file system, no persistence, no live model calls, no public hosting.
Not wired into MODULES.md, the story launcher, or any published route; adding it there would be a separate human-approved change.
